_comment: Controlled vocabulary for the changes/ topic chips. Each weekly post (changes/posts/*.md) declares a `tags:` line in its front matter; render-changes.py turns each tag into a colored chip on changes/index.html and warns on stderr for any tag not listed here. A tag's category picks its color (the same seven site hues as Features and Milestones); the eighth category, `meta`, renders as a neutral chip for non-subsystem work (talks, drafts, interop). Tag casing here is canonical: Title Case, with acronyms and product names preserved (BGP, IS-IS, gNMI, IPsec, TACACS+, ExaBGP, VPP, ...). A namespaced tag like `Presentation: LINX 126` is looked up and filtered by the part before the colon (`Presentation`) but displays in full. Keep tags atomic: the category is the broad area, the tag is the specific protocol or subsystem -- so `Routing` is never a tag, `BGP`/`IS-IS`/`OSPF` are.
